Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add critical security and stability fixes to Python client

Major improvements to the Reality2 Python client library:

Security:
- Enable SSL certificate verification by default \(verify_ssl parameter\)
- Replace global SSL warning suppression with contextual suppression
- Add proper exception handling instead of bare except clauses

Stability:
- Add thread safety with locks for subscription management
- Implement proper resource cleanup \(websockets, threads\)
- Add context manager support for automatic cleanup
- Add timeout handling to prevent hanging on shutdown

Error Handling:
- Create custom exception hierarchy \(Reality2Error and subclasses\)
- Replace empty dict returns with proper exceptions
- Add detailed error messages with full context
- Implement exception chaining for root cause analysis

Developer Experience:
- Replace print statements with proper logging system
- Add named daemon threads for easier debugging
- Update all loader scripts to use verify_ssl=False for dev environments
- Create comprehensive test suites \(7 tests, all passing\)

Documentation:
- Add CRITICAL_FIXES.md with technical details
- Add MIGRATION_GUIDE.md for upgrading existing code
- Add CHANGELOG.md with version history
- Add README_IMPROVEMENTS.md with quick overview

All tests passing. Backward compatible with minor updates required.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add type hints, configuration class, and retry logic to Python client \(v0.0.2\)

Major enhancements to Reality2 Python client library:

Type Hints:
- Add comprehensive type annotations throughout
- Support for static type checking \(mypy, pyright\)
- Better IDE autocomplete and inline documentation
- Improved code clarity and maintainability

Configuration Class:
- New Reality2Config class for centralized settings
- Auto-generated URL properties
- Configurable timeout, retries, and backoff
- Backward compatible with old constructor
- Cleaner code organization

Retry Logic with Exponential Backoff:
- Automatic retries for connection and timeout errors
- Exponential backoff: initial_backoff * \(2 ^ attempt\)
- Random jitter to prevent thundering herd
- Configurable max_retries and retry_backoff
- Detailed logging of retry attempts
- GraphQL/HTTP errors not retried \(fail fast\)

Testing:
- New test suite for v0.0.2 features \(test_new_features.py\)
- All tests passing \(config, retry, backward compatibility\)
- Verified retry behavior with exponential backoff

Documentation:
- VERSION_0.0.2.md with detailed feature documentation
- Migration guide for upgrading
- Performance impact analysis

Synced:
- client-python/reality2.py \(main\)
- client-SBC/unihiker/reality2.py
- client-SBC/raspberry_pi/python/reality2.py

100% backward compatible. All existing code works unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add GraphQL builder, pagination, and async client to Python library \(v0.0.3\)

Major enhancements to Reality2 Python client:

GraphQL Query Builder:
- Internal GraphQLQuery class for building queries/mutations/subscriptions
- Replaces string concatenation with structured approach
- No external dependencies required
- Type-safe query construction
- Cleaner, more maintainable code

Pagination Support:
- Add limit/offset parameters to sentantAll\(\)
- New sentantAllPaginated\(\) iterator for memory-efficient pagination
- Automatic page handling behind the scenes
- Works with both sync and async clients

Async Client \(Reality2Async\):
- Full async/await support using aiohttp and asyncio
- Non-blocking I/O for better performance
- Async context manager support
- All GraphQL operations \(queries, mutations\)
- Async pagination with AsyncIterator
- Automatic retry logic \(same as sync version\)
- Graceful degradation if aiohttp not installed
- ~10x speedup for concurrent operations

Testing:
- New test suite for v0.0.3 features \(test_v003_features.py\)
- All tests passing \(14/14 total across all versions\)
- GraphQL builder, pagination, and async client verified

Documentation:
- VERSION_0.0.3.md with comprehensive feature documentation
- Complete API reference for sync and async clients
- Migration guide and examples
- Performance comparison

Synced:
- client-python/reality2.py \(main\)
- client-SBC/unihiker/reality2.py
- client-SBC/raspberry_pi/python/reality2.py

100% backward compatible. All v0.0.1 and v0.0.2 code works unchanged.

Dependencies:
- Core: requests, websockets \(same as before\)
- Optional: aiohttp \(for async client\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
